summary: Revised implementation plan for the Extended Desktop GitHub Actions Android CI workflow: incorporates push/PR/tag triggers (including v* version tags), job contents:write permissions, JDK 21 Temurin + Gradle 9.3.1 caching/wrapper guard, ephemeral debug keystore generation, fail-fast unit/Robolectric tests with failure report uploads, debug APK artifact publishing, and automatic GitHub Release creation with versioned direct APK download.
